title: CISA: Scheduled Task and Service Account Audit

transcript.speaker: CISA
transcript.text: IT Security Lead, this is Agent Marquez from CISA. We’ve received your alert on the suspected logic bomb at NCIA. We’re prioritizing your case as a high-severity cyber threat.

transcript.speaker: CISA
transcript.text: We’ve confirmed the threat vector: a scheduled task on the AODB server, created by an orphaned service account. Your team has already identified it — good work.

transcript.speaker: CISA
transcript.text: We can provide remote forensic support within two hours. But we recommend immediate action: verify all scheduled tasks on critical servers, audit every service account, and look for persistence mechanisms like registry keys, startup scripts, or hidden services.

transcript.speaker: CISA
transcript.text: If you haven’t already, run a full audit of the AODB server. Check for the task named AODB_IndexMaintenance and the service account svc_nexgen_aodb. That’s your primary path to containment.

transcript.speaker: CISA
transcript.text: We’re not on-site before 12:00. You must act now. Lock down the server if you find it. Do not reboot. Preserve logs.

transcript.speaker: CISA
transcript.text: We’ll send you a secure channel for remote access shortly. Stay on the line for instructions.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the threat’s nature and pushes players toward the correct forensic actions. Watch for any delay in verifying the scheduled task or auditing the service account — that's the key gap to close.
